title: Mapped network printers
whyItMatters: Per-user printer connections reveal office or home network resources the account used, including server and share names.
source: Windows per-user mapped printers under HKCU\Printers\Connections (Microsoft Learn printer connection documentation)
notes: One subkey per connected printer. Connection strings are not read; only counts are reported. Registry last-write time is unavailable (D3).

steps: Open Settings > Bluetooth & devices > Printers & scanners.
Select each printer the plan lists and choose Remove.
Reconnect a printer you still need from the same page.
cleanup.risk: Removes the printer connections from this account. The printers stay available to other machines and can be added again.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, Fix shared printer connection problems in Windows: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/hardware/printer/fix-shared-printer-connection-problems-in-windows
